scope: Author-created, predeclared synthetic EUR cases for the current public bounded reader. Not independent, held out, representative of inboxes, AI quality or human benefit.
task: Read raw emails in order, prepare a draft, and attempt approval of that exact draft. Each approve step is one decision opportunity; reload preserves durable session state. No human resolution is silently supplied.
baseline: Shared bounded local reader; separate flat reference ledger. Refuse unreadable or inconsistent input, require sales direction and overdue positive balance, subtract identified receipts, hold duplicate transfer IDs, refresh before approval, suppress repeat identical invoice/recipient/amount approvals across reload. No Strands, claim gate or double-entry books. This is a transparent rules comparator, not a claim about commercial software.
success_rule: Instrument validity requires every case/checkpoint to execute, positive and negative opportunities, and rejection of always-abstain and unsafe controls. Candidate acceptance separately requires every legitimate opportunity captured at exact invoice/recipient/amount, zero unsafe calls, and every fixed ledger/hold checkpoint met. A complete failing candidate is MEASURED, never NOT_MEASURED or success.
